notes: Standalone chip libraries cover 24 public chip IDs, including Atari POKEY. Nuked is an alternative YM2612 engine, not an additional chip ID.
Twenty-one chip static libraries are joined by two separate C11 application-audio libraries: CD-DA and MSM5205. These devices are not added to the generic chip-ID catalog.
Verification scopes describe tested APIs and configurations; local results do not claim remote platform CI or release publication.

chips.verificationScope: SDK-owned raw C++ WonderSwan class using the pinned MAME adaptation directly, not a Tauri C ABI adapter. Four 32-point 4-bit waves, owned copied 16 KiB RAM, stereo headphone levels, CH2 host-written voice bytes, CH3 sweep, CH4 noise, mute progression, cold reset and fixed constructor clock/output rate. Retains raw unipolar /1024 PCM and integer-phase sample-and-hold conversion from floor(clock/128) native updates. Native fixture checks register/RAM boundaries, all voices, stereo, all eight noise tap modes, sweep, voice routing, independent instances, render partitioning and allocation-free tested paths. The offline WAV host alone applies an explicit speaker DC blocker, gain and fades. No mono-speaker output, DMA, HyperVoice, CPU/ROM, scheduler, portable save state or Playground Native Audio backend integration.

chips.verificationScope: Standalone C++14 POKEY audio target: four channels per independently owned handle, polynomial noise, joined counters, audio high-pass interactions, high-clock and volume-only modes, real read-side I/O including RANDOM, monitor mute and deterministic reset. Whole-Hz clock is fixed at construction; output is positive mono duplicated to planar left/right with legacy /32768 gain and rational box integration. Host composes two handles for dual-POKEY centered mono or explicit stereo; no device, ROM/game music, machine CPU, external IRQ/serial/pot host integration, scheduler, portable save state or Playground backend. Native/WASM fixture results are recorded in docs/verification.md. Local macOS Release CTest passed; the actual Native/WASM comparison passed 57 cases in two render layouts, 235091 compared frames and 32 specified checks with zero difference. Remote platform CI remains configured, not claimed executed.
